definitions.explanation: The end of a fiscal or academic year. In Japan, the fiscal year typically ends on March 31st, making late March a particularly busy time for businesses and schools.

examples.japanese: {年度末|ねんどまつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧。
examples.english: The end of the fiscal year is busy.

examples.japanese: {年度末|ねんどまつ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}い{切|き}る→使い切る：11518_tsukaikiru⟧。
examples.english: Use up the budget by the end of the fiscal year.

examples.japanese: {年度末|ねんどまつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{決算|けっさん}→決算：05973_kessan⟧⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}われている→追う：02016_ou⟧。
examples.english: I'm swamped with year-end accounting work.

notes:
⟦{年度|ねんど}→年度：00309_nendo⟧ (fiscal or school year) + ⟦{末|まつ}→〜末：31573_matsu⟧ (end). Japanese fiscal and school years run from April 1 to March 31, so {年度末|ねんどまつ} means late March, when accounts are closed, staff are transferred and schools hold graduations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年度末|ねんどまつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{決算|けっさん}→決算：05973_kessan⟧: year-end accounts
- {年度末|ねんどまつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人事異動|じんじいどう}→人事異動：18627_jinjiidou⟧: end-of-year personnel transfers
- {年度末|ねんどまつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦{消化|しょうか}→消化：04200_shouka⟧: spending leftover budget before the year ends

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧: end of the calendar year (December)
- ⟦{期末|きまつ}→期末：22375_kimatsu⟧: end of a term or accounting period
- ⟦{年度始|ねんどはじ}め→年度始め：10276_nendohajime⟧: beginning of the fiscal year
